note: Hob the shopkeeper. Trees are data: nodes {text, choices[{text, goto, if}], effects, end}. text may be a string, an array (one is picked, none repeated within the last five) or a bark token $greeting / $farewell / $idle. A choice with goto 'end' or no goto ends the talk. Conditions: flag, flag_not, hour_between [from, to], has_item [id, n]. Effects: set_flag, clear_flag, give_item [id, n], take_item [id, n]. roots: the first whose condition holds starts the talk. Lines keep to short sentences (12 words) for the voice.

farewell: Mind the dark on your way.
complaint: I apologize, I have had a headache all day.
Forgive me, my head is pounding.
I am not myself today, I fear.
Pardon me, I feel quite unwell.
My head swims. Please be brief.
I have had a dreadful ache since dawn.
Forgive my manners, I am poorly.
A fever, perhaps. I cannot think clearly.

text: Welcome to my stall, stranger. I am Hob.
I deal in tools, twine and trinkets. Trading opens soon.
Not much on the shelves yet. The carts are late.
Wolves were heard in the hills. Keep a fire lit.
The pond freezes hard in winter. Fish through the ice.

quest_offer.text: My hearth is cold. Bring me three bolts of firewood.

quest_reminder.text: Three bolts of firewood, split. I am grateful.

quest_done.text: Splendid! Take this for your trouble.
